name: Lelisu LS-258 Wireless Stereo Headphones | Bluetooth 5.4 Over-Ear Headset with Type-C Charging & LED Lights
description:
Experience immersive sound and modern style with the Lelisu LS-258 Wireless Stereo Headphones. Featuring Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity and stable single reception, these headphones deliver smooth audio transmission with low latency. Type-C fast charging ensures long playtime, while cushioned ear pads and an adjustable headband provide comfort for extended listening sessions. LED lights add a trendy touch, making this headset perfect for music, gaming, calls, or work.
Key Features
 Bluetooth 5.4 for fast, stable pairing
 Stable single reception with uninterrupted audio
 Deep bass stereo sound with crisp clarity
 Type-C fast charging for extended playtime
 LED illumination for a stylish look
 Over-ear cushioned comfort and adjustable headband
 Built-in microphone for clear calls and voice support
 Universal compatibility with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and gaming devices
How to Use
 Turn on Bluetooth on device and headset
 Pair headset via Bluetooth 5.4 connection
 Adjust headband and ear pads for comfort
 Use controls for music, calls, and LED lighting
Material
ABS Plastic, Synthetic Leather, Foam Cushions
Safety Information
 Do not expose to water or excessive moisture
 Avoid dropping or applying strong impact
 Keep out of reach of children
 Use at moderate volume to protect hearing
Package Includes
 1 × Lelisu LS-258 Wireless Stereo Headphones
 1 × Type-C Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
